title: D2ML: Models for Direct-to-Biology Small Molecule Screening
abstract: arXiv:2610.41070v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Direct-to-biology (D2B) screening enables rapid testing of newly synthesized molecules without purification. However, uncertain concentrations in crude mixtures and limited purified-compound measurements complicate the use of these data in machine learning. Here we show that models tailored to the structure of D2B data can improve prediction and guide the discovery of more potent and selective compounds. Our assay-aware models predict activity from single-point screens, relative potency across targets from crude dose-response assays, and absolute potency from purified-compound measurements. For crude assays, potency ratios between targets tested from the same well can retain selectivity information despite uncertain concentrations. A joint model that shares information across stages and balances their contributions to training improved predictions over separate neural networks. translated_title: D2ML：面向直接到生物学小分子筛选的模型
translated_abstract: 直接到生物学筛选技术无需纯化即可对新合成的分子进行快速测试。然而，粗品混合物中不确定的浓度以及有限的纯化化合物测量数据，使得这些数据在机器学习中的应用变得复杂。本研究表明，针对D2B数据结构定制的模型可以改进预测效果，并指导发现更高效、更具选择性的化合物。我们的检测感知模型能够从单点筛选预测活性，从粗品剂量响应测定预测跨靶点的相对效力，以及从纯化化合物测量预测绝对效力。对于粗品测定，在浓度不确定的情况下，从同一孔测试的靶点之间的效力比值仍可保留选择性信息。一个跨阶段共享信息并平衡各阶段对训练贡献的联合模型，相比独立的神经网络改进了预测效果。最大的性能提升体现在粗品剂量响应选择性预测方面。
tldr: 针对直接到生物学（D2B）筛选数据结构定制的机器学习模型，能够提高活性与效力预测性能，并指导发现更高效、更具选择性的小分子化合物。
en_tdlr: Machine learning models tailored to the structure of Direct-to-Biology (D2B) screening data improve potency prediction and guide the discovery of more potent and selective small molecule compounds.
